changes: No substantive changes; notes expanded to mention that both years fall in Jagajjyotir Malla's reign and that the 745/748 gap may be a numeral misreading

notes: The catalogue gives the date as NS 748 and names King Jagajjyotir Malla, but the colophon as quoted reads saṃ 745 śrāvaṇaśudi 5 and names no king or other person. The 748 may be a misreading of the numeral or a typo. Jagajjyotir Malla reigned in Bhaktapur c. 1614–1637, so both NS 745 and NS 748 fall in his reign. He is not added as a person because the colophon doesn't mention him.
